fabrication_process.name: PCBWay Via-in-Pad (epoxy-filled & capped)
fabrication_process.ordering_instructions: Order the PCBWay Via-in-Pad (epoxy-filled & capped) process (pcbway-via-in-pad): a >= 2-layer stackup with epoxy-filled and copper-capped (plated-over) vias, via drills between 0.15 and 0.5 mm, annular ring >= 0.15 mm, and in-pad vias kept >= 0.5 mm from any other component's drilled hole. Do not substitute ordinary open or merely tented vias. Source: https://www.pcbway.com/capabilities.html
